title: SPIKE Assembly View-Factor Request v1
description: Experimental SI-metre diffuse planar-patch view-factor estimation. Triangle vertex order defines the emitting side. All emitters and occluders are opaque. Unaccounted view remains unresolved, not ambient.

surfaces.description: Unique surface IDs required by runtime; at most 256 triangles total across surfaces and occluders.

triangles.description: Nonoverlapping, coplanar, consistently oriented triangles; shared triangulation edges are allowed.
